proposed_new.trigger: Empty parallel jaws approaching a top-down cube grasp after a runtime-derived yaw rotation. The first public move_to_pose times out with a partially reached free-space pose. Inputs position, downward and frame are the same existing perception-derived target pose and robot base frame; report is a dictionary with motions initialized to an empty list. Start at the current observed pose, target a stand-off0.15m above the cloud-derived grasp before descending. This wrapper reissues only typed timeout results, at most3 calls; use cap250 for pregrasp. No collision guarantee: do not retry a known obstructed contact. Each call can cost up to cap ticks, so worst-case3*250=750 ticks for pregrasp; observed selected whole policies409-533 ticks, with empty jaws during pregrasp and the cube only after closing. Preserve1000-tick whole-episode ceiling.
